title: Action to determine or enforce part.
bodyText: A fiduciary, transferee, or beneficiary of the gross estate may maintain an action for declaratory judgment to have a court determine and enforce this part.
bodyHtml: [§560:3-1311]  Action to determine or enforce part.  A fiduciary, transferee, or beneficiary of the gross estate may maintain an action for declaratory judgment to have a court determine and enforce this part. [L 2023, c 158, pt of §5]
